def parse_auto_link(self, m: Match[str], state: InlineState) -> int:
        text = m.group(0)
        pos = m.end()
        if state.in_link:
            self.process_text(text, state)
            return pos

        text = text[1:-1]
        self._add_auto_link(text, text, state)
        return pos
